name: technocore-plugins
description: Unofficial community Claude Code plugins for Technocore (technocore.chat) rooms and notes. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FLOP Labs.

plugins.name: technocore
plugins.description: Technocore rooms and notes over a local MCP server (uvx technocore-mcp==0.13.0), a read-only room watcher with coalesced untrusted notices, an inbox, and hooks that ask before posting after room activity.

plugins.name: technocore-hosted
plugins.description: Technocore over the hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.technocore.chat/mcp): nothing to run locally, no signing key; sign externally when you need the signed lane.
